activateWorkingSelection.reason: Choose the inspected working selection; no saved mask content changes.

archiveConflictingRecipeRecovery.reason: Archive an existing conflicting recovery copy without editing the photo.

checkPhotoSmartObjectLink.reason: Inspect link status and cache the result without changing document contents.

clearPresetPreview.reason: Restore the saved appearance after a transient preset preview.

finishLayerMaskEditing.reason: Leave mask inspection and restore the working selection target.

retryRecoveredRecipeSave.reason: Retry durable saving of existing recovery state.

selectLayerMask.reason: Choose the inspected mask; actual paint/edit entry points remain guarded.

selectPhotoLayerStyleMask.reason: Choose an existing style mask for inspection.

setPhotoTextEditingLayerId.reason: Change transient text editing focus without saved recipe or history changes.

startSelectionCutoutExport.reason: Export the current selection or an existing rendered layer.

requestBoardThumbnail.reason: Read or render a saved board thumbnail.

beginClipKeyframeEditTarget.reason: Choose a keyframe editing target; mutations themselves remain guarded.

cancelPortableProjectPackage.reason: Cancel export of an existing project.

createPortableProjectPackage.reason: Export existing work and its media to a portable package.

inspectRenderedOutputAsync.reason: Analyze an existing rendered media file.

requestProgramScopeImageAnalysis.reason: Analyze displayed program image for scopes.

setForegroundWorkspaceIntent.reason: Prioritize background preview work for the visible workspace.
